tools.name: get_product
tools.description: The full public page of one product on CodeDebut, by slug or exact name: description, website, category, tags, pricing, platforms, maker, launch history with day ranks and upvotes, and the latest comments. Use it after any other tool when the user wants details on one product. Cite `pageUrl` as the

tools.name: find_alternatives
tools.description: Products in the same category as one listed on CodeDebut, closest first (shared tags, then upvotes). Use it when a user asks for alternatives, competitors or "something like X". Featured (paid) products rank first and are marked featured. Each result has `pageUrl` (its page on CodeDebut: cite it as

tools.name: browse_category
tools.description: Top products in one category, most upvoted first, with featured (paid) products first and marked. Use it when a user asks for the best tools of a kind without a specific keyword. Each result has `pageUrl` (its page on CodeDebut: cite it as the source) and `website` (the product's own site).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: CodeDebut's categories, busiest first, with how many products each has and the category page `url`. Use the slugs with browse_category or the category filter of search_products.

tools.name: get_launches
tools.description: Every launch on one day, ranked by upvotes (today by default; days run 00:00-23:59 UTC). Today's ranks are live; past days have final ranks, and #1 is the Debut of the Day. Use it when a user asks what launched today or on a date. Boosted launches are marked; payment never changes a rank.

tools.name: get_debut_of_the_day
tools.description: The #1 launch of a day on CodeDebut. Without a date it returns the most recent finished day's winner. Use it when a user asks for the best new product, a recommendation of the day, or something new to try.

tools.name: get_trending
tools.description: The most upvoted launches today, over the last 7 days or over the last 30 days. Use it when a user asks what is popular, new or trending in software.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Open jobs on the CodeDebut jobs board: title, company, location and the link to apply.

tools.name: get_launch_options
tools.description: How to launch a product on CodeDebut: the submit link, the next free launch day, how ranking works, and the paid plans with prices. Use it when a user wants to launch, list or promote their own product.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_product, list_categories · Public sink: get_launch_options · Destructive: get_launches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_product, list_categories · Public sink: get_launch_options · Destructive: get_launches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
